digest.component_or_area: capabilities.py — verdict tier and provenance signing
propositions: A gateway/* provider (e.g. gateway/anthropic) without a configured base_url incorrectly stamps tier as first_class instead of best_effort, misrepresenting provenance in a signed verdict.
The tier derivation logic currently checks only cfg.base_url and misses the gateway/* provider family, even though these providers route through intermediaries that can rewrite requests.
Gateway providers must be detected via set membership in _GATEWAY_PROVIDER_NAMES to enforce the architectural guard that disallows provider name prefix matching.
Direct (non-gateway) providers without base_url must continue to stamp first_class to avoid collateral damage to existing behavior.
The endpoint_host field should remain None for gateway providers unless a base_url was explicitly configured, to report only actual configuration rather than inferred values.
